summary: Validated 50-student demo seed for MDJ dashboard. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass — seed endpoint is super_admin-only (403 for admin & student), idempotent (created=0, skipped=50, total=50, by_status matches target 12/8/8/7/6/5/4, all 6 DKI regions present in response, all 50 profiles have registered campus institusi). Fetched profile per user via /api/admin/participants/{user_id}: all 6 regions covered and all 12 'lolos' spread across all 6 regions. /api/admin/stats returns passed_by_region covering all 6 regions with total lolos=12, total_registrations>=53. Frontend (Admin): Dashboard tile shows Total Penerima Manfaat=12 and Wilayah=6; recipient-region-list renders all 6 regions (J.Selatan=4, J.Barat=2, J.Utara=2, Kep.Seribu=2, J.Pusat=1, J.Timur=1 = 12). Menu Data Peserta lists 53 rows (>=53 confirmed). ISSUE: seeded rows do NOT display a 'Mahasiswa Uji MDJ' badge/marker although backend records carry is_test_data=true & seed_batch='mdj-student-sample-2026' — grep on /app/frontend/src returned no match. Requirement #7 not satisfied on UI.

ui_bugs.issue: No visible 'Mahasiswa Uji MDJ' marker/badge next to names of seeded test records. Backend flags is_test_data=true and seed_batch='mdj-student-sample-2026' are available but unused by frontend.

action_items: Add visible 'Mahasiswa Uji MDJ' badge in AdminParticipants (and possibly participant detail) when registration.is_test_data===true OR registration.seed_batch==='mdj-student-sample-2026'. Ensure the participants list API returns is_test_data / seed_batch fields to the frontend (they are stored on registrations and can be projected in the list endpoint).
critical_code_review_comments: seed_demo_students inserts rows without a transaction; a partial failure mid-loop could leave DB inconsistent (users/profiles created without registration or vice versa). Consider try/except with cleanup or bulk_write.

seed status distribution is generated deterministically with random.Random(20260912) but statuses[region_index] swap loop can pick the same passed_index repeatedly if regions[0..5] already contain a 'lolos'; verify swap correctness with unit test.
Participants list endpoint does not project is_test_data / seed_batch to frontend row data, so no way for UI to mark test rows.
server.py still >1830 lines; recommend modularization (admin routes, auth, seed) into separate routers.
